activity_statements.statement: operates 2,000+ general merchandise retail stores across all 50 US states and DC, selling national brands and 45+ Target-exclusive owned brands
runs a supply chain network of 66 facilities that moves products to stores and directly to customer homes across the country
operates Roundel, an owned retail media advertising network that monetizes Target's first-party shopper data for brand advertisers
operates Shipt, a same-day delivery marketplace platform connecting shoppers to delivery drivers for grocery and retail orders
maintains 20+ global sourcing offices to procure merchandise including Target-exclusive private-label lines
serves 75%+ of the US population within 10 miles of a store, enabling same-day fulfillment via in-store pickup and drive-up for digital orders
employs 400,000+ team members across stores, supply chain, and corporate functions with $105B in net sales in 2025

name_reality_gap: Reads as a simple retailer; evidence shows Target is also operating a retail-media advertising network (Roundel) and a gig-economy delivery marketplace (Shipt), making it a three-sided platform business alongside its core retail operations.
extraction_notes: Strong sources from corporate.target.com. Roundel and Shipt segment weights are rough estimates; Target does not separately report these as financial segments.
